build_csrf_middleware: add CSRFMiddleware to a FastAPI app to protect state-changing endpoints with double submit cookie pattern
generate_csrf_token: generate a secure random CSRF token using secrets.token_urlsafe with 64 byte length
check_should_check_csrf: check if a request needs CSRF validation based on HTTP method and endpoint path
review_is_auth_endpoint: review if a request targets an auth-exempt endpoint that skips CSRF validation
get_csrf_token: get the CSRF token from a request's cookies for server-side rendering in forms or headers
